title: 福蒂斯油田
subcategoryTitle: 固定式平台與海上油田
subcategoryTitleEn: Fixed platforms and offshore oil fields
summary: 福蒂斯公開基礎設施資料記錄衛星平台與處理能力連接；課程研究新增模組如何改變既有系統負荷。本課依序分析新增模組重量分配、舊平台支承帳、液處理能力界面、新增輔助電力、新舊設備維修耦合，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Forties infrastructure records describe a satellite platform linked to processing capacity; this case studies integration into an existing system. The course analyses weight distribution of an added module, support-load account for an existing platform, liquid-processing capacity interface, additional auxiliary electrical load, maintenance coupling of old and new equipment, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 新增模組重量分配、舊平台支承帳、液處理能力界面
v31FocusEn: Weight distribution of an added module; Support-load account for an existing platform; Liquid-processing capacity interface

quiz.question: 關於「新增模組重量分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weight distribution of an added module" is correct?
options: 理想對稱吊裝可用總重量除以吊點數估算靜態分配，但吊索角度、重心偏移與剛度差異會增加個別吊點拉力。
四個吊點永遠各承受總重量的四分之一。
平均壓力低就代表平台基礎的所有極限狀態都合格。
optionsEn: An ideal symmetric lift divides weight among lift points, but sling angle, centre-of-gravity offset and stiffness differences increase individual tension.
Four lift points always carry exactly one quarter of the weight each.
Low average pressure proves every foundation limit state passes.
quiz.explanation: 理想對稱吊裝可用總重量除以吊點數估算靜態分配，但吊索角度、重心偏移與剛度差異會增加個別吊點拉力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「新增模組重量分配」。福蒂斯公開基礎設施資料記錄衛星平台與處理能力連接；課程研究新增模組如何改變既有系統負荷。在「福蒂斯油田」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。理想對稱吊裝可用總重量除以吊點數估算靜態分配，但吊索角度、重心偏移與剛度差異會增加個別吊點拉力。此模型只用於讀懂重量帳與荷載路徑，不能據此選吊具、起重機或批准吊裝。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The case interface is “Weight distribution of an added module”. Forties infrastructure records describe a satellite platform linked to processing capacity; this case studies integration into an existing system. An ideal symmetric lift divides weight among lift points, but sling angle, centre-of-gravity offset and stiffness differences increase individual tension. This model teaches weight accounting and load paths only; it cannot select rigging, choose a crane or authorize a lift. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 新增模組重量分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weight distribution of an added module: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「新增模組重量分配」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Weight distribution of an added module” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：T = Mg/(n cos theta)；代入 M = 235 tonne lifted mass、n = 4 lift points、theta = 30 degree from vertical，得 665 kN（「新增模組重量分配」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 M 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: T = Mg/(n cos theta); with M = 235 tonne lifted mass, n = 4 lift points, theta = 30 degree from vertical the result is 665 kN (simplified exercise for Weight distribution of an added module; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise M by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：M 增加 10% 時，結果變為 732 kN（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising M by 10% changes the result to 732 kN (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 665 kN（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 M 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 665 kN (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in M with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 針對「新增模組重量分配」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。在紙上自由體圖核對垂直分量總和等於重量，改變假設吊索角度後重算拉力，列出未包含的不均勻分配。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Weight distribution of an added module”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Check on a free-body diagram that vertical components sum to weight, recalculate tension after changing assumed sling angle, and list omitted unequal load sharing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：「新增模組重量分配」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Weight distribution of an added module” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 新增模組重量分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weight distribution of an added module: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「新增模組重量分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 「新增模組重量分配」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把吊索拉力當成垂直分力會低估斜索張力；重心或吊點剛度不一致則使四點吊裝並非四等分。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「福蒂斯油田」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Weight distribution of an added module” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Confusing sling tension with its vertical component underestimates inclined-sling force; uneven centre of gravity or stiffness also prevents equal sharing among four points. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Forties oil field”.
